list_repository_files: list the contents of a directory in a Hugging Face Hub repository using the hf:// protocol
download_file_to_local: download a remote file from a Hugging Face Hub repository to a local path with progress tracking
upload_file_to_repository: upload a local file to a Hugging Face Hub repository with optional commit message and description
copy_file_between_repos: copy a file within or between Hugging Face Hub repositories using native or download-upload methods
delete_files_from_repository: delete one or more files from a Hugging Face Hub repository with recursive and depth options
